text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser gives it her all at
the 
Diamond Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Public acclaim for Matikanetannhauser was 
soaring. The stands erupted with more 
excitement than anyone imagined, bringing 
the race to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile,
in front of the racecourse: the 
round-glasses reporter was suddenly 
transferred to another department,
just as 
she was getting passionate about the 
Umamusume beat...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unaware of any of this,
Matikanetannhauser was full of spirit and
growing 
stronger by the day! Next up at last was 
the Tenno Sho (Spring)...!
